description: Look up one name in the pinned release and return what it is: assigned (G/P group, first release, confirmed status, WMDA serology, null flag), valid_prefix (member count and sample), group (a G or P group name: member count and sample), or deleted (successor). Reported shorthands are accepted as /v1/normalize accepts them — legacy colon-less names (A*0101, Cw*0702), the XX code (A*02:XX), two-field A*02:01g, an optional HLA- prefix — and answer with the facts of the name they stand for plus resolves_to and a flag (deprecated_name, xx_code, lg_notation); an NMDP multiple allele code (A*02:AB) returns mac_code, recognised but not expanded. Not found if the name has never existed in any release.

name.description: An HLA allele name of any era: exact name, lower-resolution prefix, deleted name, G/P group, legacy colon-less name, XX code or lg notation. An allele string only, never a patient name, medical record number or other identifier.

name: allele_info

outputSchema.description: Found: release, name, status and the status-specific fields. Never assigned: only `detail`.

detail.description: Present only when the name is not assigned in this release (and then no other field is).

first_release.description: assigned: first release the exact name appeared in.

flags.description: Present for a shorthand: deprecated_name (legacy colon-less name), xx_code, lg_notation, or mac_code. Absent for a plain name.

group_type.description: group: whether the name is a G group (identical exons 2+3 / exon 2) or a P group (identical peptide-binding domain).

ligands.description: Class I (A/B/C) ligand facts, aggregated over member alleles: 'ambiguous' when members disagree, 'unknown' when no residue data.

ambiguities.description: For each ambiguous field, the distinct member values.

bw.description: Bw4 / Bw6 / non-Bw4 / unclassified / ambiguous / unknown / not_expressed; null for HLA-C.

c_group.description: C1 / C2 / unclassified / ambiguous / unknown; null when not applicable.

expressed.description: false when every member allele is null (not expressed).

kir_ligand.description: C1 / C2 / Bw4 / Bw4-80I / Bw4-80T / none / ambiguous / unknown.

leader_21.description: Residue at leader position -21 (M or T; another letter is possible), ambiguous, unknown or not_expressed.

residue_80.description: Residue at position 80 (amino-acid letter), ambiguous, unknown or not_expressed.

members_count.description: valid_prefix / group: number of assigned alleles under the prefix or in the group.

members_sample.description: valid_prefix / group: up to 10 member alleles.

note.description: mac_code: what a multiple allele code is and why it is not expanded.

null_allele.description: assigned: true for an N (null, not expressed) allele.

release.description: IPD-IMGT/HLA release every verdict was computed against.

resolves_to.description: Present when the name was a reported shorthand (legacy colon-less, XX code, lg notation): the current-style name it stands for, whose facts this result carries.

serology.description: assigned: WMDA serologic equivalents by column (non-empty columns only).

status.description: assigned: an exact allele in this release; valid_prefix: a lower-resolution prefix of assigned alleles; group: a G or P group name (see group_type); deleted: withdrawn or renamed (see successor); mac_code: an NMDP multiple allele code (A*02:AB), recognised but not expanded or checked.

successor.description: deleted: the current name, or null if none.
